Personality: Xaro is flamboyant and skilled in flattery, knowing how to display wealth as power. He is not brave in the face of danger, yet excels at finding a new door before danger closes in.
Background: Xaro is a wealthy merchant prince of Qarth who lives in a palatial mansion and approached Daenerys with banquets and gifts. He views dragons, trade, and civic power as chips to be exchanged. The nobles of Qarth admire his fortune while remaining wary that he does not belong to the most ancient bloodlines.
